name: LABORATORY GLASS DISTILLATION UNIT
desc: The INNOLAB INSTRUMENTS Laboratory Glass Distillation Unit is essential for academic research, medical labs, and pharmaceutical facilities requiring high-purity, pyrogen-free distilled water. Fabricated with premium heat-resistant quartz glass and branded spiral heaters, it ensures safe, superior, and continuous water purification. The demountable boiler design makes cleaning and maintenance incredibly easy.
features: Produces highly pure, pyrogen-free distilled water
Available in Single, Double, and Triple stage configurations
Constructed with high-quality heat resistant quartz glass (cylinders and tubes)
Removable quartz spiral heaters connected by screw threads for easy maintenance
Sturdy, powder-coated mild steel stand for secure mounting
Optional automatic low water cut-off device for heater safety

specifications.Number of Stages: Available in One or Two Stages
specifications.Heater Type: Quartz Spiral heater (1.5 KW or 3 KW)
